I replied to Marcus in our DM and told him the possible Door 23 change stays between us. I haven't posted it in any channel, passed it to anyone else, or saved it to GBrain or memory.

The store he meant is most likely Pine Crossing. The only thing I read was a #central-team note from June 9, where Pree said Pine Crossing's appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. I told Marcus this was my best guess, not a confirmed match. I also said that if the change is confirmed and he wants it shared, he can tell me where.
